_readme: One entry per service page. Rendered to services/<slug>.html by build/generate.mjs, sharing the nav, footer, booking form and floating buttons with the homepage. Order here sets the order of the Related Services cards.

pages.title: Live Music Entertainment | Swahili Jazz
pages.description: Swahili Jazz performs at corporate events, weddings, festivals, hotels, private celebrations and diplomatic functions across Kenya.
pages.lede: The band reads a room before it plays one. A quiet dinner set and a main festival stage need different things, and we bring the right one.

hero.alt: Juma Tutu performing on stage at a jazz festival

paragraphs: Swahili Jazz performs as a full band, a compact ensemble or a solo instrumentalist. The line-up is chosen around your event rather than sold to you as a fixed package.
Our sound brings together accomplished musicianship and modern jazz. It works as background music over dinner, and it still works when the floor fills after midnight.

image.alt: The Swahili Jazz horn section performing live

pages.title: Entertainment Agency | Swahili Jazz
pages.description: Book bands, solo artists, saxophonists, DJs, MCs and traditional performers through one accountable contact in Kenya.
pages.lede: We book music for people who cannot afford for it to go wrong. Tell us the event and we put forward acts that fit it.

hero.alt: Trumpet and saxophone players performing at a festival

paragraphs: Swahili Jazz books more than its own band. We represent and work alongside musicians across Kenya, so a single brief can cover the entire night.
You get one point of contact, one contract and one team responsible for the music. If an act falls through, replacing them is our problem rather than yours.

image.alt: Musicians performing together on a festival stage

pages.title: Events Production | Swahili Jazz
pages.description: Stage design, sound, lighting, technical production and coordination for corporate events and festivals in Kenya.
pages.lede: We build the event around the music rather than bolting music onto it. Stage, sound, lighting and running order come from one team.

hero.alt: A live stage production under coloured lighting

paragraphs: Swahili Jazz produces events in full. We take a concept, work out what it needs technically, build it on site and run it on the day.
Because we are musicians, the sound is designed for live performance instead of being treated as an afterthought. That difference is audible from the first song.

pages.title: Record Label | Swahili Jazz
pages.description: Recording, production, mixing, mastering, distribution and artist development from the Swahili Jazz studio.
pages.lede: Our studio exists so original music is recorded properly, by people who understand how it is meant to breathe.

hero.alt: The Swahili Jazz recording studio control room

paragraphs: Swahili Jazz runs its own studio and label. We record our catalogue there, and we open the room to artists working in the same tradition.
Sessions are engineered by people who play. That matters most when you are tracking horns, live drums and a room full of musicians at the same time.

image.alt: A recording session in progress at the studio

pages.title: Artist Management | Swahili Jazz
pages.description: Talent development, career and brand management, releases, media and business affairs for musicians in Kenya.
pages.lede: We manage a small roster properly rather than a large one loosely. The aim is a career that still works in ten years.

hero.alt: A Swahili Jazz artist photographed with his saxophone

paragraphs: Swahili Jazz manages musicians at different stages, from players still finding their sound to established names touring internationally.
The work is practical. Rehearsal discipline, sensible fees, releases that actually land, and a plan the artist has agreed to rather than been handed.

image.alt: Portrait of a Swahili Jazz artist with his saxophone
